title: Food Safety No Fridge
description: Plain-text guide to keeping food safe in a power outage: fridge and freezer safe times, the 40°F threshold, coolers and dry ice, and FoodSafety.gov keep-or-discard lists. Covers refreezing, food that touched floodwater, refrigerated medicines, and cooking temperatures.
shortDescription: 4-hour fridge and 24/48-hour freezer rules, and what to keep or toss
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
